name: pitcrew
description: A multi-model development crew for Codex: Crew Chief decides, Luna builds, Sol supervises execution.

interface.shortDescription: Crew Chief decides. Luna builds. Sol supervises.
interface.longDescription: A bounded multi-model coding workflow for Codex. The main thread owns architecture and final approval, while Sol supervises Luna's implementation and local correction loop. Healthy execution stays inside the cell without short-interval Crew Chief polling until PASS or a real design escalation.
defaultPrompt: Use Pit Crew to implement this change.

Keep architecture and final approval in the main thread. Have Sol supervise Luna until the execution cell reaches PASS. Avoid short-interval busy polling while workers are healthy, and return to the main thread only for a real escalation or final review.
